Metadata.title: HoliJoy · Where hotel animators meet
Metadata.description: A marketplace for animators, hotels and holidaymakers, built on guest reviews. Coming soon.

Home.title: Find the stars of hotel entertainment.
Home.subtitle: HoliJoy makes animators' reputations visible through guest reviews and connects hotels and holidaymakers with the right team.

animators.title: Animators
animators.body: Build your profile and showreel, collect reviews from guests with your own QR code, and reach hotels directly on WhatsApp.

hotels.title: Hotels
hotels.body: Search animators by branch, language and rating; reach them on WhatsApp in one tap and show your team on your profile.

guests.title: Holidaymakers
guests.body: Rate and review your favourite animators in seconds, no sign-up needed, and compare hotels by the quality of their entertainment.
